comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Technically correct. However, there are a few items which act as a substitute for Caution skill.

1. Equipment with the EX Effect Reduce incidence of attacks - this skill effect means invisible ships do not ambush you and there is a chance (based on EX skill rank) that visible ships will not attack you either. I believe R5 Quarters ornaments can give a similar effect but I do not use R5 Quarters and cannot say for certain.

I think this equipment is the best to acquire as it is not UWC: Holy Water Sprinkler

2. Decorative Small Boat Blueprint is a consumable which can prevent NPC ship attacks for a 24-hour period. It's not easily acquired however.

3. Pets with the Area caution skill work much the same way, preventing invisible ship ambushes and occasionally preventing visible NPC attacks. Taiwan Magpie and Wombat are freely acquired from quests; Sea Lion and Capybara are UWC only. Note that you must have Pet Training skill to activate pet skills, however.

There are many options as you can see. For row grinding, a pet seems the best course unless you like to use master smith tools to constantly repair a weapon slot item.

Best of luck finding the solution that suits you and your playstyle. Cheers.
